name: Ballao (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of green and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ballao (a boar on blue beneath a yellow chief) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Ballao, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 23 July 2004.

features.role: Ballao arms — boar on blue beneath a yellow chief, crowned, within branches
